question: Should this PR require real Feishu Open Platform proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the mocked-client source proof for this media fallback fix?
rationale: The code shape is narrow and follows the existing helper, but repository policy treats external channel delivery changes as needing real behavior proof unless a maintainer intentionally waives that gap.

options.title: Require Real Feishu Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a short recording from a real Feishu setup showing image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal before merge.

options.title: Accept Mocked Seam Proof
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally merge based on the source-level proof while owning the remaining live transport uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require Real Feishu Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a short recording from a real Feishu setup showing image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored and merged the existing Feishu reply fallback contract that the PR extends.
